chooseBaseBanner: The rank of the first card you send to a foundation becomes the starting rank of all eight
emptyStockAriaLabel: The stock is empty (there is no redeal)
autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a card can reach a foundation
chooseBase: Send a first card to a foundation to fix the starting rank

tutorial.foundation: There are eight foundations. They build up in **alternating colour, not by suit** -- you choose the starting rank, and King wraps round to Ace, 13 cards each. 8 x 13 = 104 wins.
tutorial.terrace: The eleven cards on the left are the terrace. **Its top card can only go to a foundation** -- never to the tableau -- and it is never refilled. Letting it stall is how you lose.
tutorial.tableau: Nine tableau piles. Build down in **alternating colour**, wrapping Ace round to King. **Only one card moves at a time.**
tutorial.emptyPile: When a pile empties it refills **automatically** from the waste, or from the stock if the waste is empty. There is no manual fill.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste. **There is no redeal -- one pass only.**
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.

hintReason.chooseBase: Nothing reaches a foundation until the starting rank is fixed
hintReason.fromTerrace: The terrace only ever reaches a foundation and never refills -- spend it while you can
hintReason.toFoundation: Sending this card to a foundation frees up the board
hintReason.toTableau: Take the suggested tableau move to dig out the pile
hintReason.draw: Nothing can move, so turn a card from the stock
